title: Real or Only Wanted?
goal: Choose between indicative and subjunctive after que by asking whether the thing is real, also in the past.
grammar: Mood contrast in relative clauses: indicative or subjunctive

items: I can choose between indicative and subjunctive after que by asking whether the thing is real.
I can say what I needed in the past, using the imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the new words for chargers and sockets.
